steps.texte: OK FOODS CAMEROUN is a food-processing company that makes biscuits, dairy products, sweets, wafers, chewing gum and chocolate spreads.
From a grain of wheat to thousands of biscuits sold to date, our journey into the food industry officially began here.
In response to market demand, we decided to diversify our product range.
We introduced a new product range. Today, we are the only local wafer manufacturer.
As a major player in the food industry, we decided to offer the market high-quality confectionery at affordable prices.
Our chocolate spread is rich and creamy, with a taste like no other.
